results.title: Breaking changes in third-party APIs are turning into a full-time job | Hacker News
results.content:
We've seen cases where one missed change gets very expensive. An endpoint that doesn't work in production can take an app down for several minutes. It can have an impact on your team's productivity and on your sales, or simply on your image, because your app looks less reliable.

To fix that, we built okapi.bot. Its agents scan your repo and learn how your code calls each API. When a vendor changes something, Okapi opens pull requests that keep those connections up to date.

As an example, here are 13 breaking changes coming in November:
